sections.title: Hair and eyes with van
sections.content: You know *Barna haja van.* (She / he has brown hair.) Eyes work the same way: *Kék szeme van.* *Kék szeme van.* (She / he has blue eyes.) New words: *szem* (eye), *hosszú* (long), *rövid* (short) and *szemüveg* (glasses). The adjectives go in front of the noun. To ask, say *Milyen a haja?* and answer *Hosszú és szőke.*

items.english: Anna is tall. She has brown hair.

items.spanish: Milyen a haja? – Rövid és barna.
items.english: What is his hair like? – Short and brown.

sections.content: There is no *he* or *she* in these sentences: *haja* and *szeme* already say whose hair and eyes they are. Name the person in the sentence before.
